title: Residency
description: Where requests are actually served from, by region and tenant, and the residency violation counter. Provisioned from infra/k8s/monitoring/dashboards/; edits made in the Grafana UI are not saved.

panels.title: Requests per second, by region and tenant
panels.description: Every request the gateway served, split by the region it was resolved to and the tenant that sent it.

panels.title: Residency violations per second, by tenant
panels.description: Expected flat at zero. A residency refusal is a deny-by-default 451 and moves only gateway_requests_total's status label (see that family's own docstring), not this counter - the resolver never widens regions on failure, so this counter is zero by construction rather than by luck.
